verdict.rationale: AutoGen is installed and run as a self-hosted Python library (pip install), and AutoGen Studio teams can be exported to Python or run in a Docker container. That implies the user decides where agent state and logs physically live. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly addresses storage location, region selection or data residency, and the documented install path pairs it with external model providers such as OpenAI. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of data storage location and residency controls, guidance on keeping model-provider traffic in-region, any hosted region options, independent corroboration.
